testName: OmniStudio Calculation Matrix & Pricing Procedure Execution
steps:
1. Open OmniStudio Calculation Matrix "Auto_Insurance_Premium_Matrix"
2. Verify active version 2.0 has inputs: Driver_Age_Group, Vehicle_Class, Coverage_Level
3. Open Calculation Procedure and click "Simulate"
4. Provide test inputs: Driver_Age_Group="25-35", Vehicle_Class="SUV", Coverage_Level="Comprehensive"
5. Click "Calculate"
6. Verify calculated output premium equals exactly $142.50 / month
7. Provide edge case: Driver_Age_Group="16-20"
8. Verify matrix correctly applies youthful operator surcharge factor (1.8x) yielding $256.50
